scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Shramyogi Prathibhavan Vidyarthi Yojana (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB)
Worker must have at least one year of regular membership and an active membership with the Board
Child must have scored at least 85 % in senior secondary (10+2) board exam or at least 75 % in a bachelor’s degree and must be a regular student in the next class or course
Benefits are limited to the first three children of the worker
The worker must not have previously received similar financial assistance from any government department/board/corporation for the same class of the child
Institutions must be approved by statutory bodies (UGC, AICTE, PCI, MCI, etc.) and established within India
For commercial pilot training, institutions approved by the Director General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) are eligible
Applicants cannot be eligible for benefits under any other already approved financial assistance scheme of the HBOCWWB
benefits_summary: Provides tuition fee reimbursement, up to ₹72,000 for hostel fees, a one‑time ₹49,000 for laptop/computer, and ₹5,000 per year for books and stationery for eligible students.
